rationale: Island is a nominal location category.
Bill length is a continuous measurement.
Bill depth is a continuous measurement.
Flipper length is a measured quantity.
Body mass is a measured quantity.
Sex is represented as a nominal category.
Year is an ordered temporal field.
UCI defines dteday as a date.
Season is category-coded; either categorical or ordinal is acceptable for visualization generation.
Weekday codes identify nominal day categories.
Working day is a binary indicator.
Weather situation is category-coded and also has an interpretable severity ordering.
Total rentals is a numeric count; either numeric treatment is acceptable.
